tool_config.name: prepare_vouch
tool_config.description: Vouch for the next loan of someone she has paid, or been paid by, at least 3 times on Plus ("I vouch for Funmi"). Checks she is in good standing; read back that no money is ever taken from her and that she can't vouch for 6 months if the loan isn't repaid; she types her PIN on screen.

name.description: The person's name as she said it, e.g. "Funmi".
